segments.thag4.3:1.1: [dha. pa.6 dhammapadepi]“Pare ca na vijānanti, mayamettha yamāmase;
segments.thag4.3:1.3: Ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.
segments.thag4.3:2.3: Vijānanti ca ye dhammaṃ, āturesu anāturā.
segments.thag4.3:3.1: “Yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṃkiliṭṭhañca yaṃ vataṃ;
segments.thag4.3:3.3: Saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
segments.thag4.3:4.3: Ārakā hoti saddhammā, nabhaṃ puthaviyā yathā”ti.
